edition.title: Apostolatus officium — Ioannes Baptista Boucho episcopus Ataliensis praeficitur — Rome: Ex Typographia Polyglotta S. C. de Propaganda Fide, 1902.

work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Apostolic letter CCCXXII provides the priest Jean-Baptiste Boucho to the see of Attalia in partibus infidelium, dispenses him from residence and empowers any Catholic bishop to consecrate him after the profession of faith and oath; address, intitulation, greeting “Dilecte fili”, body, non obstantibus clause and dating clause survive. Issuer evidence: GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF56158–56158; the source dating clause at LF56290–56293 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die decima iunii millesimo octingen- tesimo quadragesimo quinto, pontificatus Nostri anno decimo quinto. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
